quote: A subsidiary of Glenfarne Group , LLC (“Glenfarne”) today announced the completion of a previously announced acquisition of four energy projects in Chile with a combined 909 Megawatts (“MW”) of installed capacity comprised of 588 MW of solar and associated battery energy storage system (“BESS”) facilities with a capacity of 1.61 Gigawatt-hours (“GWh”) (321 MW equivalent). Glenfarne acquired the assets from Metlen Energy & Metals (“METLEN”). … The transaction is valued at $865 million including the assumption of debt
note: Opened Glenfarne company primary 2026-10-04; USD 865m / 588 MW solar / 1.61 GWh BESS / northern Chile confirmed.
